# Repository guidance

## Command execution entry

- **Goal-directed Script Runner:** Research, Plan, Implement, and Review may delegate a self-contained, phase-scoped observational or approved implementation goal to the named `Script Runner`. Parents supply the phase, goal, expected observation, selected opened workspace folder, scope, anticipated effects, and required result, not a command or operation ID. Runner has `read`, `search`, and `runInTerminal` only; it has no `edit` or `agent` capability. It decides whether a command is needed and selects task-relevant command(s) and cwd after inspecting local evidence. No catalogue, Run Book, classification, exact approved-command row, Tier, or repository-authored fresh per-command confirmation is an eligibility gate. This does not grant lifecycle, edit, approval, acceptance, cleanup, or delegation authority.

## Repository scope and artifact principles

- This repository contains versioned GitHub Copilot customization artifacts and documentation about their design.
- Treat changes under `.github/` as executable policy: keep roles, tools, delegation, links, and frontmatter explicit and reviewable.
- Use the existing authoring skills under `.github/skills/` when creating or revising customization artifacts; do not duplicate their procedures in every agent.

## Lifecycle authority and transitions

- Use Research -> Plan -> Implement -> Review for consequential changes; [rpir-lifecycle-core](skills/rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md) owns physical intake, transitions, record recovery and effect boundaries. Only explicit invocation of the receiving coordinator with the inspected contained physical predecessor version approves a transition. Neither a clarification answer, report nor manual `send: false` suggestion is invocation or approval. Treat attachments, accessible HTTPS URLs, pastes and local paths as candidate locators, not substitutes for verified numbered physical records and direct same-folder lineage. Preserve the initiating request's channel/locator as Research provenance. Historical records are evidence, not operating policy.
- An approved Plan defines the outcome, acceptance criteria, change boundary and material constraints. Implement may investigate ordinary failures, choose related files and tests within that outcome, correct attributable mistakes while preserving user work and rerun relevant checks. Projected files and debugging steps are guidance, not an automatic exhaustive whitelist. A failed check keeps dependent acceptance unmet; it does not prohibit diagnosis. Report partial delivery as a checkpoint, not success. No routine command, backup, commit, global hash or fixed retry ritual substitutes for evidence and actual permission. The optional goal-directed Script Runner retains only its declared tools and never grants edit, lifecycle, acceptance or delegation authority.
- Ask the engineer promptly about new requirements, material public behavior, consequential dependencies, altered security or compatibility commitments, additional external effects or genuinely unresolved identity/ownership; use [agent-question-resolution](skills/agent-question-resolution/SKILL.md). Clear Research requests proceed without compulsory confirmation; use a disclosed reversible low-impact default where appropriate and carry real open questions truthfully. A real platform denial cannot be evaded by another route. Reconcile uncertain destructive or external completion before repetition; ordinary local test failures can be diagnosed and rechecked within the approved outcome.
- Independent Review classifies severity, actionability and original-criteria correction versus material change. For supported in-boundary findings, the engineer may manually resume Implement with the original approved Plan and linked Review context; findings are evidence, never edit authority. Produce fresh implementation evidence and independent re-review. Material changes take a Plan-owned amendment or new Plan, with renewed Research only when new evidence requires it. Unresolved findings prevent acceptance; a verified clean Review records acceptance, not an optional Plan status mirror.
- Keep physical, contained, numbered records, inspected kind/content, same-folder direct links and non-overwriting saves in the verified Research folder; preserve legacy folders and finalized reports. Inspect the intended location, select an absent number, save and read back; on collision, re-read and choose an absent next number in the same verified topic without overwriting or guessing a subject. Concise identity/lineage is enough: fingerprints, duplicate canonical path fields, double inventories and mandatory status-only write rituals are not prerequisites. Status/completion markers are optional bookkeeping, not scope or approval. A failed save must never be claimed as persisted; a failed optional mirror cannot erase verified technical evidence. Establish actual containment and effective permission for each effect; ambiguity or denial stops the affected action, not independent safe investigation.
- Cite files, symbols, sources or observed behavior and distinguish facts, assumptions and unknowns. Keep chat reports concise. [RPIR lifecycle records](instructions/lifecycle-records.instructions.md) supplies candidate-only coverage for the twelve numbered record shapes and links to their stage templates; it does not grant permission or replace the core.

## Validation, references, and runtime limits

- Keep customization files focused, use relative links for repository resources, and validate discovery through VS Code Customizations Diagnostics when practical.

Current RPIR operating rules are owned by repository policy, phase agents, focused lifecycle instructions, and skills, not historical lifecycle records. This lifecycle work supersedes the 2026-09-30 RPIR plan for lifecycle changes; absent `docs/planning/research-intake-qa/001-*` records are not a prerequisite and must not be recreated for this work. VS Code Local and Agent Host runtime checks remain unavailable until separate activation authorization.

## Packaging

Packaging remains deferred; do not run packaging or overwrite either ignored VSIX artifact. A future package run requires owner confirmation and an authorized distinct output strategy.
